company.name: DineSafe.com
company.description: DineSafe.com offers restaurant goers a decision making tool for figuring out where to eat out by reviewing health inspection hazard reports of North American restaurants. Currently covering over 271,198 establishments in most metro regions of the US west coast, New York, Massachusetts and Canada, DineSafe.com is a one-stop-shop for restaurant food safety information.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,955,603 to $3,955,603, a 1x increase.

caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 81 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 32 (-11).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
